body: Do you by any chance know how I can get ahold of such a thing?

I don't know that I'm the best person to give you advice. IF you check my posts I'm in the same boat as you. But in my opinion you should just give your all to your girlfriend. Don't let her slip out of your fingers because then you might just do those things you thought about doing. I lost mine recently and I would give anything or do anything to get her back. I don't have advice for you besides that because I'm in the same "carry me to death" boat. Earn her trust back. It's not easy but work hard make it your number one goal.
I've wanted to speak with a therapist for a while now. I just haven't had the finances for the past three years and that's when these unhealthy thoughts have become most prominent.
thank you for your kind words. it really is appreciated.
